entry_contract: Continue from 34 Swamp of Sorrows & Stranglethorn Vale, or select this chapter on a partially completed character. Begin in Hillsbrad Foothills with Magistrate Henry Maleb. Leave at least two quest-log slots open.

steps.instruction: Travel from Stranglethorn Vale to Hillsbrad Foothills. Use a known flight path when it saves time; otherwise follow roads and zone connections. Continue to [G48.14,59.11 Hillsbrad Foothills]. [O]
